constitutions.label: Constitution A: Privacy-First Productivity

raw_input.we_are: a privacy-first productivity tool for knowledge workers who value deep focus
raw_input.we_never: sell user data, show ads, or use dark patterns to increase engagement
raw_input.we_value: simplicity over feature count, user trust over growth metrics, offline-first over cloud-dependency

axes.target_user: privacy-conscious knowledge workers who prioritize deep focus and data ownership
axes.prohibited_business_model: data monetization, advertising, engagement-maximizing dark patterns
axes.quality_bar: simplicity and minimalism; fewer features done well over feature bloat
axes.strategic_terrain: offline-first productivity; local data storage with optional sync
axes.trust_compliance_rule: zero telemetry by default; explicit opt-in for any data sharing; GDPR-first

forbidden_patterns: social features that expose user activity
cloud-only storage with no local option
A/B testing that degrades user experience

constitutions.label: Constitution B: Growth-First Collaboration

raw_input.we_are: a data-driven collaboration platform for fast-moving startup teams
raw_input.we_never: sacrifice speed for perfection, or block users from experimenting
raw_input.we_value: rapid iteration over polish, team visibility over individual privacy, growth metrics over aesthetic

axes.target_user: startup teams (5-50 people) that ship fast and iterate weekly
axes.prohibited_business_model: slow enterprise sales cycles, per-seat pricing that blocks adoption
axes.quality_bar: speed of iteration; ship daily, polish monthly
axes.trust_compliance_rule: transparency over privacy; team activity is visible by default; analytics-first

forbidden_patterns: features that require admin approval to use
hiding usage data from team leads
